description: WhatsApp through a self-hosted WAHA instance.
subtitle: {{ $parameter.operation }}: {{ $parameter.resource }}

parameters.label: All
parameters.description: Include all environment variables

parameters.label: As Note
parameters.description: Send as video note (aka instant or round video).

parameters.label: Chat Id
parameters.description: Chat ID

parameters.label: Code
parameters.description: Group code (123) or url (https://chat.whatsapp.com/123)

parameters.label: Color
parameters.description: Color number, not hex

parameters.label: Color Hex
parameters.description: Color in hex

parameters.label: Contacts
parameters.description: Contact list to send the status to.

parameters.label: Download Media
parameters.description: Download media for messages

parameters.label: Duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds. 24 hours (86400), 7 days (604800), 30 days (2592000)

parameters.label: Filter From Me
parameters.description: From me filter (by default shows all messages)

parameters.label: Filter Timestamp Gte
parameters.description: Filter messages after this timestamp (inclusive)

parameters.label: Filter Timestamp Lte
parameters.description: Filter messages before this timestamp (inclusive)

parameters.label: Force
parameters.description: By default, it gracefully stops the server, but you can force it to terminate immediately.

parameters.label: Id
parameters.description: WhatsApp Channel ID or invite code from invite link https://www.whatsapp.com/channel/11111

parameters.label: Logout
parameters.description: Stop and logout from the session.

parameters.label: Message Id
parameters.description: NOWEB engine only - it's important to mark ALL messages as seen

parameters.label: Method
parameters.description: How would you like to receive the one time code for registration? |sms|voice. Leave empty for Web pairing.

parameters.label: Name
parameters.description: Session name (id)

parameters.label: Participant
parameters.description: NOWEB engine only - the ID of the user that sent the  message (undefined for individual chats)

parameters.label: Phone
parameters.description: The phone number to check

parameters.label: Phone Number
parameters.description: Mobile phone number in international format

parameters.label: Reaction
parameters.description: Emoji to react with. Send an empty string to remove the reaction

parameters.label: Refresh
parameters.description: Refresh the picture from the server (24h cache by default). Do not refresh if not needed, you can get rate limit error

parameters.label: Reply To
parameters.description: The ID of the message to reply to - false_11111111111@c.us_AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

parameters.label: Session
parameters.description: Session name

parameters.label: Sort By
parameters.description: Sort by field

parameters.label: Sort Order
parameters.description: Sort order - descending (Z => A, New first) or ascending (A => Z, Old first)

parameters.label: Start
parameters.description: Start session after creation
